name: list_billing_charges
description:
Retrieve a Vercel team's billing charges (FOCUS v1.3) between from (inclusive) and to (exclusive), at 1-day granularity for up to 1 year. Returns summary totals by currency, service, and category plus a bounded sample of records. Available only to the Owner, Member, Developer, Security, Billing, and Enterprise Viewer roles on the team.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/billing/charges --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

from.description: Inclusive start of the date range as an ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

to.description: Exclusive end of the date range as an ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC.
